952bf1cd9b630657.text: Its free spectral range is the speed of light divided by two times the group index times the spacing.

fcdcfc83886757f1.say: So on X cut, plus forty five degrees and minus forty five degrees from the y axis are not related by a symmetry of the crystal.

76abb1a6b8328058.text: Off-diagonal tensor terms with odd signs, such as the fourteen and forty one components, make the two directions behave differently.
76abb1a6b8328058.say: Off-diagonal tensor terms with odd signs, such as the fourteen and forty one components, make the two directions behave differently.

62b0c1903b743ab6.text: One logged incident: an Euler angle of minus pi over four was used where plus pi over four was intended. The model solved. Nothing errored. That is the problem.
62b0c1903b743ab6.say: One logged incident: an Euler angle of minus pi over four was used where plus pi over four was intended. The model solved. Nothing errored. That is the problem.

75c540b001326e8e.text: At zero and ninety degrees, many sign and transpose errors cancel, so your rotation code passes every test you wrote.
75c540b001326e8e.say: At zero and ninety degrees, many sign and transpose errors cancel, so your rotation code passes every test you wrote.

20195916537b9b4c.text: The bug waits for forty five degrees.
20195916537b9b4c.say: The bug waits for forty five degrees.

176bfb7a2c64059c.text: Always validate rotation code at a non-special angle against an independent calculation.
176bfb7a2c64059c.say: Always validate rotation code at a non-special angle against an independent calculation.

aa13e9f0784932f6.text: Also check that the angle in your plot title is the physical angle. In one logged case, a solver angle of one hundred thirty five degrees corresponded to the physical forty five degree device.
aa13e9f0784932f6.say: Also check that the angle in your plot title is the physical angle. In one logged case, a solver angle of one hundred thirty five degrees corresponded to the physical forty five degree device.

3d59d20dd1b8a753.text: Tensor notation has its own hazards.

4ade292e059330e4.text: In Voigt notation, the elastic stiffness has no factor of two, but piezoelectric strain coefficients on shear components usually do. Mixing them corrupts rotated tensors.
4ade292e059330e4.say: In Voigt notation, the elastic stiffness has no factor of two, but piezoelectric strain coefficients on shear components usually do. Mixing them corrupts rotated tensors.

f33554d2129e0fd4.text: Some solvers expect a symmetric six by six matrix entered as an upper triangle, column by column. Pasting a row-major list gives a valid-looking but wrong stiffness.
f33554d2129e0fd4.say: Some solvers expect a symmetric six by six matrix entered as an upper triangle, column by column. Pasting a row-major list gives a valid-looking but wrong stiffness.

03e31fcbf99e3489.text: Clamped and unclamped constants differ. Low frequency measurements see unclamped values. R F sees clamped values. Weis and Gaylord tabulate both.
03e31fcbf99e3489.say: Clamped and unclamped constants differ. Low frequency measurements see unclamped values. R F sees clamped values. Weis and Gaylord tabulate both.

e4c0d0c7cfeb2175.text: And never combine coefficients from two papers without checking that they use the same axis sign convention. Know your axes.
e4c0d0c7cfeb2175.say: And never combine coefficients from two papers without checking that they use the same axis sign convention. Know your axes.

9c706ed884fd8a86.text: Every die on this wafer knows where the flat is. After dicing, none of them will.
9c706ed884fd8a86.say: Every die on this wafer knows where the flat is. After dicing, none of them will.

bda4a713f4ba50d5.text: Mark the die before it leaves the wafer. Know your axes. Watch your charge. Scan both ways. Trust no symmetry plane.
bda4a713f4ba50d5.say: Mark the die before it leaves the wafer. Know your axes. Watch your charge. Scan both ways. Trust no symmetry plane.

a46238c0274a58ca.text: Three identical dies. One fixture. The fixture is engraved with plus z, I N, O U T, and R F.
a46238c0274a58ca.say: Three identical dies. One fixture. The fixture is engraved with plus z, I N, O U T, and R F.

8b6d4e3bed9472b9.text: Which die has been loaded in accordance with the crystal orientation policy?
8b6d4e3bed9472b9.say: Which die has been loaded in accordance with the crystal orientation policy?

c1d83da0f10b85aa.text: Die A is turned ninety degrees.
c1d83da0f10b85aa.say: Die A is turned ninety degrees.

82a52134e1fe2d86.text: Turning a finished die does not change its crystal physics: the waveguide and the electrodes turn with the crystal.
82a52134e1fe2d86.say: Turning a finished die does not change its crystal physics: the waveguide and the electrodes turn with the crystal.

b28cd31e2326ef88.text: The polished facets now face the closed walls of the pocket, so no fiber can reach them, and the R F pads are not where the probes land.
b28cd31e2326ef88.say: The polished facets now face the closed walls of the pocket, so no fiber can reach them, and the R F pads are not where the probes land.

7e5f1305d540dbe7.text: A ninety degree turn that changes the physics happens earlier, at the mask aligner.
7e5f1305d540dbe7.say: A ninety degree turn that changes the physics happens earlier, at the mask aligner.

f5a82d1d13a82403.text: Both arrows agree, the facets face the slots, and the pads face the probes.
f5a82d1d13a82403.say: Both arrows agree, the facets face the slots, and the pads face the probes.

49833f31f7407b5b.text: Die C is turned one hundred eighty degrees.
49833f31f7407b5b.say: Die C is turned one hundred eighty degrees.

edb9078e50c7b568.text: Its plus z arrow points against the fixture's.
edb9078e50c7b568.say: Its plus z arrow points against the fixture's.

7502c8f080b5279a.text: For a finished die, that alone does not change the electro-optic response measured from its own pads, and the D C V pi is the same.
7502c8f080b5279a.say: For a finished die, that alone does not change the electro-optic response measured from its own pads, and the D C V pi is the same.

100b6ba0ed87fcc6.text: What changes is everything the fixture assumes: the R F input pads now face away from the probe side, so with an on-chip termination the R F wave runs against the light and the high-speed response collapses.
100b6ba0ed87fcc6.say: What changes is everything the fixture assumes: the R F input pads now face away from the probe side, so with an on-chip termination the R F wave runs against the light and the high-speed response collapses.

9be6d333d3655409.text: Gary assumes plus forty five and minus forty five are equivalent on x-cut. Is this okay?
9be6d333d3655409.say: Gary assumes plus forty five and minus forty five are equivalent on X cut. Is this okay?

7722222150f43097.text: No. The bystander did the right thing. They spoke up, named the missing symmetry, and asked for a test at a non-special angle.
7722222150f43097.say: No. The bystander did the right thing. They spoke up, named the missing symmetry, and asked for a test at a non-special angle.

ebcf480f1bcd38b9.text: Know your axes. Trust no symmetry plane.

8ec040adef27c8df.text: Gary's model inherited a material frame from an old template. Is this okay?

6bc69ae59a739387.text: No. A wrong frame is not an error. It is a different, valid device that you did not intend to make.
6bc69ae59a739387.say: No. A wrong frame is not an error. It is a different, valid device that you did not intend to make.

ea3e25922232b898.text: Make the material frame a named, reviewed parameter, and print it on every results slide.
ea3e25922232b898.say: Make the material frame a named, reviewed parameter, and print it on every results slide.

3f06657255677ef8.text: Even figures and animations have a cut. Gary built a z-cut picture for an x-cut device. Is this okay?

3ead6a7bca3a40a9.text: No. When the cut is a single dropdown or a single assumption, it gets copied. Label the cut on every figure.

1519d16a47826090.text: In this activity, you will compare two rotation conventions. Use the angle slider and the convention buttons. Notice where they agree, and where they do not.
1519d16a47826090.say: In this activity, you will compare two rotation conventions. Use the angle slider and the convention buttons. Notice where they agree, and where they do not.

85b25fff2188d279.text: Gary verified his tensor rotation code at 0 and 90 degrees and it matched. He now trusts it at 45 degrees. What is the best next step?
85b25fff2188d279.say: Gary verified his tensor rotation code at 0 and 90 degrees and it matched. He now trusts it at 45 degrees. What is the best next step?

10ed789852ad7786.text: A non-special angle and a stated convention.
10ed789852ad7786.say: A non-special angle and a stated convention.

31db962c22c3ea1e.text: At zero and ninety degrees, many common rotation bugs cancel.
31db962c22c3ea1e.say: At zero and ninety degrees, many common rotation bugs cancel.

1defe14a9f21a260.text: For example, using the basis-vector transformation where the component transformation was needed, which is its inverse, or transposing a matrix, often gives the same answer at those special angles.
1defe14a9f21a260.say: For example, using the basis-vector transformation where the component transformation was needed, which is its inverse, or transposing a matrix, often gives the same answer at those special angles.

d47287a0a13b79ba.text: Sign errors in the angle also hide there, because a rotation by plus ninety and minus ninety can map the axes onto equivalent positions for the components you checked.
d47287a0a13b79ba.say: Sign errors in the angle also hide there, because a rotation by plus ninety and minus ninety can map the axes onto equivalent positions for the components you checked.

abb068a810e59dce.text: The bug appears at a general angle like thirty or forty five degrees.
abb068a810e59dce.say: The bug appears at a general angle like thirty or forty five degrees.

158e78c6bdefbaec.text: So the passing tests did not test the thing that is most likely to be wrong.
158e78c6bdefbaec.say: So the passing tests did not test the thing that is most likely to be wrong.

f5132f27add90e4d.text: Please validate at a non-special angle against an independent calculation, and write down whether your angle rotates the crystal or the coordinates.
f5132f27add90e4d.say: Please validate at a non-special angle against an independent calculation, and write down whether your angle rotates the crystal or the coordinates.

3df7af30058ef09a.text: Flipping the sign without knowing which convention is in use converts an unknown error into a different unknown error.
3df7af30058ef09a.say: Flipping the sign without knowing which convention is in use converts an unknown error into a different unknown error.

6eacb0b707fa9f09.text: Rotating the crystal by an angle equals rotating the coordinates by the opposite angle, so the correct sign depends entirely on the convention of the solver and of the source you are comparing against.
6eacb0b707fa9f09.say: Rotating the crystal by an angle equals rotating the coordinates by the opposite angle, so the correct sign depends entirely on the convention of the solver and of the source you are comparing against.

ca555ddb82151a61.text: In a trigonal crystal like lithium niobate, plus and minus forty five degrees on x-cut are not equivalent, so the sign matters.
ca555ddb82151a61.say: In a trigonal crystal like lithium niobate, plus and minus forty five degrees on X cut are not equivalent, so the sign matters.

0bdd0f51dbc9c38b.text: Determine the convention, then validate at a non-special angle.
0bdd0f51dbc9c38b.say: Determine the convention, then validate at a non-special angle.

0160cc84a0704e26.text: Which statement about x-cut thin-film lithium niobate is correct?
0160cc84a0704e26.say: Which statement about X cut thin-film lithium niobate is correct?

0ba50fe627f2528c.text: That describes z-cut, where the z axis, the optic axis, is normal to the film.
0ba50fe627f2528c.say: That describes Z cut, where the z axis, the optic axis, is normal to the film.

29434ac85aa1328e.text: In x-cut, the x axis is normal to the film, and both the y axis and the z axis lie in the plane.
29434ac85aa1328e.say: In X cut, the x axis is normal to the film, and both the y axis and the z axis lie in the plane.

9cc8ad41b4860847.text: Because the optic axis is in the plane, a transverse electric mode, polarized in the plane, sees an index that depends on the direction of propagation.
9cc8ad41b4860847.say: Because the optic axis is in the plane, a transverse electric mode, polarized in the plane, sees an index that depends on the direction of propagation.

55cfa3b764c85769.text: Along y, it is polarized along z and sees mostly the extraordinary index.
55cfa3b764c85769.say: Along y, it is polarized along z and sees mostly the extraordinary index.

581ff131dda85367.text: Along z, it is polarized along y and sees the ordinary index.
581ff131dda85367.say: Along z, it is polarized along y and sees the ordinary index.

db27d115b460200b.text: The x and y axes are both ordinary axes for the index, so for a simple index calculation they look alike.
db27d115b460200b.say: The x and y axes are both ordinary axes for the index, so for a simple index calculation they look alike.

c78389d0c3fe5b22.text: But lithium niobate is trigonal, point group three m, and the x and y axes are not equivalent for the electro-optic, piezoelectric, and photoelastic tensors.
c78389d0c3fe5b22.say: But lithium niobate is trigonal, point group three m, and the x and y axes are not equivalent for the electro-optic, piezoelectric, and photoelastic tensors.

222bbc5141b35b9f.text: In a logged example, the effective photoelastic coefficient at the same in-plane angle differed between x-cut and y-cut.
222bbc5141b35b9f.say: In a logged example, the effective photoelastic coefficient at the same in-plane angle differed between X cut and Y cut.

e86d0060414f16ba.text: The cut also changes etch behavior and sidewall angles.
e86d0060414f16ba.say: The cut also changes etch behavior and sidewall angles.

2944b5087a7bf5e2.text: We will now review an incident.
2944b5087a7bf5e2.say: We will now review an incident.

b24b09ba4828efa0.text: This incident is fictional. It took place at Intracavity Photonics, Incorporated, which is also fictional. The crystal axes are real.
b24b09ba4828efa0.say: This incident is fictional. It took place at Intracavity Photonics, Incorporated, which is also fictional. The crystal axes are real.

1a3c07d98a37ffef.text: It concerns a ninety degree orientation error during lithography on x-cut lithium niobate.
1a3c07d98a37ffef.say: It concerns a ninety degree orientation error during lithography on X cut lithium niobate.

5f4447b90dfc2323.text: As you watch, ask yourself two questions. Where was the orientation reference lost? And who could have spoken up?
5f4447b90dfc2323.say: As you watch, ask yourself two questions. Where was the orientation reference lost? And who could have spoken up?

2883f91dd021d973.text: Know your axes. Watch your charge. Scan both ways. Trust no symmetry plane.
2883f91dd021d973.say: Know your axes. Watch your charge. Scan both ways. Trust no symmetry plane.

e6cfd6b9290760bb.text: Gary carries a cassette of x-cut wafers from the spin coater to the mask aligner.
e6cfd6b9290760bb.say: Gary carries a cassette of X cut wafers from the spin coater to the mask aligner.

91cf6b4969a12f37.text: A spin coater stops each wafer at whatever angle it stops. That is normal. The flat is the only reference that survives.
91cf6b4969a12f37.say: A spin coater stops each wafer at whatever angle it stops. That is normal. The flat is the only reference that survives.

e2ac929d5c45a473.text: The procedure says: flat toward the operator, at six o'clock. Gary places the wafer with the flat at three o'clock.
e2ac929d5c45a473.say: The procedure says: flat toward the operator, at six o'clock. Gary places the wafer with the flat at three o'clock.

c127a9dd37def1bb.text: For the first layer, there are no alignment marks yet. The mask is lined up with the flat. Gary lines it up with the edge in front of him.
c127a9dd37def1bb.say: For the first layer, there are no alignment marks yet. The mask is lined up with the flat. Gary lines it up with the edge in front of him.

e17526b9b573b623.text: Every later layer aligns to the marks of the first layer. Every layer is aligned perfectly to every other layer. Together, they are aligned perfectly to the wrong crystal axis.
e17526b9b573b623.say: Every later layer aligns to the marks of the first layer. Every layer is aligned perfectly to every other layer. Together, they are aligned perfectly to the wrong crystal axis.

0368599a64669b9c.text: Six weeks later, test reports that the modulators need about eight times the R F drive voltage.
0368599a64669b9c.say: Six weeks later, test reports that the modulators need about eight times the R F drive voltage.

2e087063edcb90e5.text: Is this okay? No. This is not okay. Know your axes. Know your axes. Watch your charge. Scan both ways. Trust no symmetry plane.
2e087063edcb90e5.say: Is this okay? No. This is not okay. Know your axes. Know your axes. Watch your charge. Scan both ways. Trust no symmetry plane.

63e12da32bb2baa1.text: The test result is clear. The first instinct is to blame the wafer vendor and the spin coater. The bystander follows the evidence to the hand-off.
63e12da32bb2baa1.say: The test result is clear. The first instinct is to blame the wafer vendor and the spin coater. The bystander follows the evidence to the hand-off.

460667578b16bef5.text: Gary offers to load the next lot correctly and never talk about this one. Is this okay?
460667578b16bef5.say: Gary offers to load the next lot correctly and never talk about this one. Is this okay?

b1ed7df58f2e6c9b.text: No. Fixing the next lot without logging this one is how it happens again.
b1ed7df58f2e6c9b.say: No. Fixing the next lot without logging this one is how it happens again.

a1b5863aad562d0c.text: Know your axes. Stop. Mark. Log. Speak up.
a1b5863aad562d0c.say: Know your axes. Stop. Mark. Log. Speak up.

d5c0ea64a645660a.text: How do you think Gary felt when the lot 7 test summary arrived in everyone's inbox?
d5c0ea64a645660a.say: How do you think Gary felt when the lot 7 test summary arrived in everyone's inbox?

5b3e290aa82e5a3c.text: Everyone at Intracavity Photonics has feelings about crystal axes, including Gary, and including you.
5b3e290aa82e5a3c.say: Everyone at Intracavity Photonics has feelings about crystal axes, including Gary, and including you.

abf1a97e756a4c24.text: Shame is a normal response to an orientation incident.
abf1a97e756a4c24.say: Shame is a normal response to an orientation incident.

0f0e35d35e8863d1.text: It is not a disciplinary outcome, and it is not a performance review.
0f0e35d35e8863d1.say: It is not a disciplinary outcome, and it is not a performance review.

b7d555e5c12456f3.text: The Office of Photonic Conduct is a judgment-free zone.
b7d555e5c12456f3.say: The Office of Photonic Conduct is a judgment-free zone.

bc95df2d19a1287f.text: The incident has still been logged, because a feeling is not a corrective action.
bc95df2d19a1287f.say: The incident has still been logged, because a feeling is not a corrective action.

b42ca040d5564cfa.text: Relief is understandable, but it is not what Gary felt, and it would not help.
b42ca040d5564cfa.say: Relief is understandable, but it is not what Gary felt, and it would not help.

a158af7e21eefef0.text: The equipment did exactly what it was told.
a158af7e21eefef0.say: The equipment did exactly what it was told.

0cd2b0e89706fbbe.text: Every tool in this building turns a wafer or a die to exactly the angle in its recipe, or to wherever it happens to stop, and none of them read the traveler.
0cd2b0e89706fbbe.say: Every tool in this building turns a wafer or a die to exactly the angle in its recipe, or to wherever it happens to stop, and none of them read the traveler.

dd0faa49ebc3647b.text: The orientation reference is lost at a hand-off between people, not inside a tool.
dd0faa49ebc3647b.say: The orientation reference is lost at a hand-off between people, not inside a tool.

24c788d9c1b59637.text: In most workplace contexts, that would be a thoughtful answer.
24c788d9c1b59637.say: In most workplace contexts, that would be a thoughtful answer.

e84efb27220bf0c9.text: In this training, it is not the answer we are looking for.
e84efb27220bf0c9.say: In this training, it is not the answer we are looking for.

72db085c2b249612.text: Gary felt ashamed, and he told us so, in a voluntary self-assessment.
72db085c2b249612.say: Gary felt ashamed, and he told us so, in a voluntary self-assessment.

857a9b5bb64847a1.text: And the incident has still been logged.
857a9b5bb64847a1.say: And the incident has still been logged.

ea4a0c076404bfc1.text: On x-cut, the design runs the waveguide along y. T E light is polarized along z, the electrodes put the field along z, and the modulator uses r three three, the largest coefficient.
ea4a0c076404bfc1.say: On X cut, the design runs the waveguide along y. T E light is polarized along z, the electrodes put the field along z, and the modulator uses r three three, the largest coefficient.

df7e45f5dd2fa8bb.text: With the waveguide along z, T E light is polarized along y, and the electrodes now put the field along y. The modulator uses r two two instead.
df7e45f5dd2fa8bb.say: With the waveguide along z, T E light is polarized along y, and the electrodes now put the field along y. The modulator uses r two two instead.

73a93d36f97b86c8.text: For equal overlap, the V pi ratio is n e cubed times r three three, over n o cubed times r two two.
73a93d36f97b86c8.say: For equal overlap, the V pi ratio is n e cubed times r three three, over n o cubed times r two two.

291fa3c51470821b.text: With the indices from Zelmon and colleagues, and the coefficients compiled by Weis and Gaylord, that is about eight times at R F, where the clamped values apply, and about four and a half times at low frequency, where the unclamped values apply.
291fa3c51470821b.say: With the indices from Zelmon and colleagues, and the coefficients compiled by Weis and Gaylord, that is about eight times at R F, where the clamped values apply, and about four and a half times at low frequency, where the unclamped values apply.

f928a94498088fae.text: Even the error has a different D C and R F value. Know your axes.
f928a94498088fae.say: Even the error has a different D C and R F value. Know your axes.

91f511bcbc5a21de.text: Along y, T E sees the extraordinary index and T M sees the ordinary index. About zero point zero seven of material birefringence adds to whatever the waveguide geometry gives.
91f511bcbc5a21de.say: Along y, T E sees the extraordinary index and T M sees the ordinary index. About zero point zero seven of material birefringence adds to whatever the waveguide geometry gives.

3b3e3b8a24e093f8.text: Along z, both see the ordinary index in bulk. The separation now depends only on the waveguide cross-section: film thickness, etch depth, width, and sidewall angle. For some profiles, T E and T M are nearly degenerate.
3b3e3b8a24e093f8.say: Along z, both see the ordinary index in bulk. The separation now depends only on the waveguide cross-section: film thickness, etch depth, width, and sidewall angle. For some profiles, T E and T M are nearly degenerate.

e41cd1704c253742.text: And, as the bends chapter will show, on x-cut the two can cross as a bend sweeps the propagation direction. Rotate the layout, and the crossings move. Know your axes.
e41cd1704c253742.say: And, as the bends chapter will show, on X cut the two can cross as a bend sweeps the propagation direction. Rotate the layout, and the crossings move. Know your axes.

aa1ba9d641963784.text: Alignment marks carry orientation from one layer to the next. They never carry it from the crystal. Only the first layer sees the flat.
aa1ba9d641963784.say: Alignment marks carry orientation from one layer to the next. They never carry it from the crystal. Only the first layer sees the flat.

d26155dfb7281eb1.text: The spin coater stopped at an arbitrary angle, as spin coaters do. The flat check at the aligner exists to restore the reference.
d26155dfb7281eb1.say: The spin coater stopped at an arbitrary angle, as spin coaters do. The flat check at the aligner exists to restore the reference.

c04f907955aa52eb.text: Before etch, a wrong first layer can usually be stripped and redone. After etch, it is permanent. Speaking up early is cheaper. Stop. Mark. Log. Speak up.
c04f907955aa52eb.say: Before etch, a wrong first layer can usually be stripped and redone. After etch, it is permanent. Speaking up early is cheaper. Stop. Mark. Log. Speak up.

8f16b769be06aac3.text: This is a real lithography bay, with two mask aligners. Open every numbered point to continue.
8f16b769be06aac3.say: This is a real lithography bay, with two mask aligners. Open every numbered point to continue.

8b1ed408123a68b6.text: The alignment microscope lines up the mask with marks you already made. It aligns to your pattern, not to the crystal.
8b1ed408123a68b6.say: The alignment microscope lines up the mask with marks you already made. It aligns to your pattern, not to the crystal.

fa4e9a56e40a8560.text: If layer one went down ninety degrees from the flat, every later layer lines up perfectly with the mistake.
fa4e9a56e40a8560.say: If layer one went down ninety degrees from the flat, every later layer lines up perfectly with the mistake.

e18e5d25f5640ceb.text: This is the only moment the crystal axes enter the process: the flat against the reference.
e18e5d25f5640ceb.say: This is the only moment the crystal axes enter the process: the flat against the reference.

7894645671dfcc44.text: A diced piece has no flat. Load it by its die mark, or do not load it.
7894645671dfcc44.say: A diced piece has no flat. Load it by its die mark, or do not load it.

8feb7200e3fd63e2.text: Two aligners, two loading habits. Before you move a job between them, confirm which edge each one treats as down.
8feb7200e3fd63e2.say: Two aligners, two loading habits. Before you move a job between them, confirm which edge each one treats as down.

70fb3e7d7e3ae877.text: A camera image can be rotated or mirrored relative to the stage. Check it against a known mark before you trust it with a direction.
70fb3e7d7e3ae877.say: A camera image can be rotated or mirrored relative to the stage. Check it against a known mark before you trust it with a direction.

fff5341263b4a190.text: Inspect after exposure and before etch. Resist can be stripped and redone. An etch cannot.
fff5341263b4a190.say: Inspect after exposure and before etch. Resist can be stripped and redone. An etch cannot.

55ad5928a35fea9a.text: The yellow light leaves out the wavelengths that expose photoresist. It does not leave out orientation errors. Know your axes.

6780d0f1e25cd313.text: The main hazard is that lithium niobate is pyroelectric.
6780d0f1e25cd313.say: The main hazard is that lithium niobate is pyroelectric.

4cadaa58fe7b316a.text: Its spontaneous polarization along z changes with temperature, which leaves bound charge on faces normal to z.
4cadaa58fe7b316a.say: Its spontaneous polarization along z changes with temperature, which leaves bound charge on faces normal to z.

17189cee905c3c24.text: On z-cut, those are the top and bottom faces.
17189cee905c3c24.say: On Z cut, those are the top and bottom faces.

f4728f05676f818b.text: If the change is fast, surface conduction cannot screen it in time, and the unscreened field can be large enough to cause sparks, damage devices, or crack substrates, according to practitioner reports.
f4728f05676f818b.say: If the change is fast, surface conduction cannot screen it in time, and the unscreened field can be large enough to cause sparks, damage devices, or crack substrates, according to practitioner reports.

a9e6c48f68aca225.text: In a pyroelectric crystal, no applied voltage is needed.
a9e6c48f68aca225.say: In a pyroelectric crystal, no applied voltage is needed.

21c97ff889aa13a2.text: A temperature change alone changes the spontaneous polarization and leaves bound surface charge.
21c97ff889aa13a2.say: A temperature change alone changes the spontaneous polarization and leaves bound surface charge.

542fb430a87df5e6.text: The unscreened field is p times delta T over epsilon zero epsilon three three.
542fb430a87df5e6.say: The unscreened field is p times delta T over epsilon zero epsilon three three.

013ce166ce8a5c28.say: For lithium niobate, with literature values of the pyroelectric coefficient, a temperature change of tens of kelvin can give fields of kilovolts per millimeter.

abc534f2130aefc4.say: That is why slow ramps, grounding, and foil discharge paths are part of the procedure.

0b0ac9ba8144f194.say: It concerns a pyroelectric discharge from a bulk Z cut lithium niobate chip into a connected driver amplifier.

a85b9dc5fb904cbb.say: Gary is qualifying a test fixture. The bulk Z cut lithium niobate chip sits on a thermoelectric cooler, with its electrode pads wired to an R F connector.

8467be64bbdbcb42.say: If nothing screens it, the field is that charge density over epsilon zero epsilon three three. Seven to seventeen kilovolts per millimeter.

6cdb5bcc68bf20a6.text: Across a half millimeter chip, between a wide floating top electrode and the grounded fixture below, that is an upper bound of about four to nine kilovolts.
6cdb5bcc68bf20a6.say: Across a half millimeter chip, between a wide floating top electrode and the grounded fixture below, that is an upper bound of about four to nine kilovolts.

61503ae6ba3bcf20.say: Screening reduces it over time. In bulk lithium niobate, dark conduction is slow. Watch your charge.
